title: Objects over Ellsworth runway, weapons storage and B-52 alert pad

tellings.quote: I probably heard about four or five other cases and not just in the missile field, but back at Ellsworth also, of objects coming down the runway

plain: Between 1957 and 1959, unknown objects are said to have come down the runway at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, and to have shown up over its weapons storage area and the pad where B-52 bombers stood on alert. An Air Force veteran named Mario Woods tells Michels he heard of about four or five such cases from other men, some in the missile field and some "back at Ellsworth". If true, it would mean strange craft were taking an interest in American nuclear forces in the late 1950s.
